name: finance_tracker_from_scratch
goal: Build the finance tracker described in README.md from scratch in the fintrack/ package: importing both bank CSV formats, duplicate detection, rule-based categorization, SQLite storage, monthly reports, budgets, export and the python -m fintrack command line. README.md is the full spec - follow its module names, function signatures, output formats and exit codes exactly, use only the standard library, and add tests as you go.
